The €500bn infrastructure fund and >1%-of-GDP defense ramp is now flowing into the data — July composite PMI 51.9, fastest manufacturing output growth since March 2022, Germany expanding for the first time in four months — yet EWG/EFA is still -7.2% YTD and has turned +2.0% over the past month. Buying the confirmed inflection, not the knife. Crowded alternative (periphery: EWI/EWP 96th percentile) argues Germany is the non-consensus expression. Key catalysts: Aug 21 flash PMIs, Aug 25 Ifo, Sep 10 ECB — hawkish ECB over-hike or China relapse are the falsifiers; the stop sits just above the 52-week low so a new low ends the trade with the thesis disproven.
